iv. Aldehydes are oxidized easily than ketones. Why?

v. Hydration of aldehyde and ketone can be catalyzed by both acid and base, but addition of hydrogen cyanide can only be catalysed by base. Why?

viii. Why lower aldehydes and ketones are highly soluble in water, although there is no acidic hydrogen available in these compounds?

ix. The carboxylic acid(s) formed upon oxidation of ketones, must have carbon atoms less than parent ketone. Why?
